id: title:dmarchuk:only tell customers a fetch is being retried when it is

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the HogExecutorAsyncService retry scheduling and customer-facing logging.
review.reason: Adds a computed variable `willRetry` to gate customer-facing retry logs and scheduling, while removing the previous direct use of `canRetry`. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement for the HogExecutorAsyncService, which is an event-driven workflow component. The implementation and relevant checks are visible in the diff.
review.uncertainty: The exact operational benefit and potential incident avoidance are not independently verified; this score relies solely on the observed code changes and their placement in the workflow execution path.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test and implementation changes. No score assigned.
